286a6 2007，byand between340ST.MARKS"'AVENUE’HOUSINGDEVELOPMENTFUND CORPORATION, a New York corporation,having an address at 340 St. Marks Avenue, Brooklyn, New York 11238 ("Owner"), and 336 OCEAN EMPIRE, LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 1060 Ocean Avenue, Suite A1, Brooklyn, New York 11226 ("Developer") (Owner and Developer are sometimes hereafter collectively referred to as the "Parties"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with a building and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, County of Kings, City and State of New York, known as Lot 25 in Block 1153 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 340 St. Marks Avenue, Brooklyn, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"; the building located thereon or which maybelocated thereon in the future is herein referred to as the "Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS,Developer is the owner in fee of certain land, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, County of Kings, City and State of New York, known as Lot 23 in Block 1153 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork, and as and by the street addresses 336 St. Marks Avenue,Brooklyn, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “B” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the “Developer Land"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct a new building on all or a portion of the Developer Land, (the new building and improvements, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Building,” and the Developer Land and the Developer Building are sometimes herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Parcel"), the Owner Parcel and DeveloperParcel are sometimes herein referred to separately as a “Parcel”or collectively as the“Parcels"; WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than may be used on the Owner Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and that certain Transferable Development Rights or TDR (as hereinafter defined) are availablefor transfer to and utilization on the Developer Land; WHEREAS, Developer desires to have additional floor area attributed to the Developer Parcel and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for a Merged Zoning Lot (as hereinafter defined) so as to make the TDR available for utilization on the Developer Parcel,and Owner is willing to make 1

such TDR available to Developer in perpetuity; WHEREAS, Owner and Developer have previously executed a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions - a/k/a Exhibit IV (the “Declaration") in accordance with certain Resolution in order to create a single zoning lot of the Owner Parcel and the Developer Parcel (such zoning lot is herein referred to as the“Merged Zoning Lot”as more particularly described on Exhibit “C” annexed hereto and made a part hereof), and (ii) such other agreements, easements and licenses as are necessary to effectuate the intent of the parties in connection with the TDR (this Agreement, the Declaration and such other agreements, easements and licenses are herein collectively referred to as the “Zoning Documents"); WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Merged Zoning Lot and other matters. NOW THEREFORE,in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: 1. Certain Definitions.As used herein: (a) alteration permit or otherwise from the NYC Department of Buildings or such applicable governmental agencyhaving jurisdiction over theParcels. (b)“Development Rights” shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lotby erecting or adding thereon a structure or structureswith a total floor area and other certain characteristics calculated by (i) multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the floor arearatio establishedfor structuresin the zoning district or districts inwhich the zoning lot is located, (i) the inclusion of any bonus floor area available to the zoning lot pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, including, without limitation Section 23-90 et seq. thereof, and (ii) thefurther inclusion of any use,bulk(including,but not limited to,floor area, lot coverage, open space, open space ratio, etc.), density, and other rights permitted under the ZoningResolution andwhich maybe authorized tobe developed by the appropriate agency of the City of NewYork from time to time.
